children.doc: /** 🎚️ Window panes, window measures: the sliders, selects, toggles and numbers a window declares as measures, their tree items, overlay and chrome and the dom id qualification. */
/** 🪛️ Window panes, utility bar options: the options of the selection utility and the utility bar node. */
/** 📝️ Window panes, staged args: the staged argument controls (reference, color, vector, number) and the form gate of an action. */
/** ⌨️ Window panes, keyboard chords: the editable-target and keyboard-ownership guards, the canonical chord tokens, the chord matcher and the keybinding intent. */
/** 📋️ Window panes, clipboard activation: the clipboard fragment of an effect, the paste action with its retained fragment and the utility activation. */
